title: Jesus calms the Storm
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child narrates Jesus calming the storm (Matthew 8:23-27) and lists lessons: trust Jesus, call on him, his power over nature.

floor.question: Name a miracle of Jesus.
floor.answer: Changing water into wine (healing Simon's mother-in-law)

representations: the disciples' words on a card
steps: Act out the storm and the calm.
contexts: a child facing a hard problem

board.do: Wait for the child to say he calmed the storm.

misconceptions.ask: What was Jesus doing when the storm began?
In the calming of the storm, did Peter walk on water?
What should we do when we are afraid?
misconceptions.repair: Say: the disciples called on Jesus and he helped. We can too.

checks.question: What was Jesus doing in the storm?
Name a lesson from the miracle.
